title: Document Structure & Layout (exact skeleton + required slide fields)
guideline_note: Rule 21, added by the user on 2026-07-13: the TR doc must follow the exact ordered layout and every slide must carry its required fields. Amended 2026-08-10 (harness 1.29): `analogy` left the required set and became conditional on the slide's `role` — requiring it everywhere is precisely what produced an analogy on comparison, reasoning and worked-example slides. `role` and the doc-level `coverage_map` joined the required set; placement is scored by the analogy_placement set.
description: The doc must follow this exact order: (1) Session name/title; (2) Recap of the previous session, whose bullets ARE the previous session's key takeaways (omitted only for Session 1); (3) Agenda of the current session; (4) one section breaker PER agenda item, in agenda order; (5) slides; (6) Key Takeaways; (7) Next session name; (8) closing 'Thank You | All the Best'. EVERY slide must contain role, heading, subheading, content, visual_guidance and speaker_notes. `analogy` is conditional (present iff role == concept_intro) and is NOT checked here. The doc must also carry a `coverage_map` with one entry per key takeaway.
criterion: Order correct; recap present with prev-session takeaways (non-first); one section per agenda item; every slide has role, heading, subheading, content, visual_guidance, speaker_notes; coverage_map present with one entry per takeaway; ends with upcoming-session name + 'Thank You | All the Best'.

rubric.5: Exact order; recap = prev takeaways; one section per agenda item; every required slide field present; coverage_map present and complete; correct closing.
rubric.3: Order correct but one slide missing one field, or recap paraphrased instead of using the takeaways.
rubric.1: Wrong order, a missing structural block, sections != agenda items, a slide missing a required field, or a missing/incomplete coverage_map.

cases.rationale: Full skeleton in order; recap = prev takeaways; 3 agenda → 3 sections; all six fields on every slide; correct closing.
Session 1 correctly omits recap; rest of the skeleton intact.
Slide 2 has no analogy — a required field is missing.
4 agenda items but only 2 section breakers — not one section per agenda item.

recap_bullets: A brand-new summary unrelated to the previous session's takeaways

cases.rationale: Recap does not carry the previous session's key takeaways.
Missing next-session name and wrong closing (must be 'Thank You | All the Best').

input.slides: all six fields present on every slide

cases.rationale: No coverage_map: the sub-concept enumeration is unverifiable, which is how a missing sub-concept used to pass unnoticed.
A comparison slide with no analogy is CORRECT now — it must not be failed for a missing field the way the old six-field rule did.

conditional_slide_fields.analogy: present iff role == concept_intro — scored by the analogy_placement set
